sources.behavior: The exact rc.2 source changes the join to waitForTreeWork: only a shared subagent-tree root joins progressing whole-tree work; ordinary members return false. Queue, cancellation, disposal-abort, prompt and lifecycle frame behavior is preserved. Additive replacement policy observes Jobs only; activation retains its historical registered-descendant gate.

sources.sourceBasis: One complete official Git clone and local rc.2..rc.3 source-tree comparison; independently downloaded actual rc.3 npm archive and fresh npm graph. selection: The current port admits exact rc.3 plus the unchanged audited compiled digest only. Earlier source/npm observations are historical, not alternate accepted runtime versions. Unknown or changed bytes are refused before driver mounting.
